title: Lucky Thirteen Blue Slush Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Lucky Thirteen’s Blue Slush is possibly the ultimate berry slushy flavour, with rich, deep notes of sweet blueberries layered with sharp, tangy raspberry and a refreshing streak of menthol for an uplifting exhale. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend fuses fantastic flavour and cloud production, while the high nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for newer ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
